note: Where scripts/results-morning.mjs looks for each council's own declaration of result. `contests` pins a known declaration URL for one ballot; `councils` gives the page the declaration is expected to join, scanned for a link naming the ward with 'declaration' or 'result'. `exclude` drops a link that matches (an older declaration for the same ward). Locations for the 12 November 2026 contests were read on 3 November 2026 with an honest user agent; none of these pages is disallowed by robots.txt and none showed a bot check. They are where each council posted its previous by-election notices or results, not a promise that the declaration will appear there.

hyndburn.notes: WordPress Download Manager. The title sits beside a bare 'Download' link and the href carries the filename, so the text before the link is part of the match. Baxenden 2025 was published here as a PDF.

north-east-lincolnshire.notes: robots.txt asks for a 30 second crawl delay; one request per run. No earlier by-election declaration was found to confirm the format.

oldham.notes: The notices page also lists Royton North (3 December), so the ward name decides. Older by-election results are on the ModernGov results list.

staffordshire-moorlands.notes: Cheadle South East (2022) was a 647 KB PDF that may be a scan; a scan has no text and stays pending for a hand read.

suffolk.notes: Mid Suffolk runs the Bosmere division count. The results page already lists 'Suffolk County Council (Bosmere Division May 2026)', the scheduled election, which must not be read as the by-election.

wigan.notes: Wigan Central (2025) was 'Declaration of Result of Poll - Wigan Central' with a filename that names no ward, so the link text decides.
